神話の狼、フェンリル着ぐるみセット
フードの顔は完全にキマってます。しかし中身の本人は無表情です。

Prompt:
"cute fenrir wolf onesie outfit, silver-white and icy blue hooded kigurumi, hood front features a deranged unhinged wolf face, mismatched button eyes with spiral pupils, one eye bulging and one eye tiny, crooked jagged stitched mouth with too many sharp teeth, lolling tongue, pointed fluffy ears, hood rests on neck when down, thick fluffy fur collar, fluffy and textured fur-like cloth material, oversized sleeves, large fluffy wolf tail with icy blue tip, cute wolf-paw slippers with soft pads, small broken chain motif details on the cuffs, soft fluffy fabric texture, silver white and icy blue color palette"
※被写体プロンプト（オリジナルキャラ等）に付け加えて使ってください
#空野ワールド #空野ファンタジー雑貨店 #AIプロンプト

analysis.summary: 神话巨狼芬里尔主题的连体毛绒服饰提示词，包含疯狂表情的狼头兜帽、纽扣眼和爪子拖鞋等细节。
analysis.summaryEn: Prompt for a mythical Fenrir wolf onesie costume featuring a deranged wolf hood, mismatched button eyes, and paw slippers.

promptValidation.evidence: Images 1-3 precisely display the silver-white and icy blue wolf onesie with the manic button-eyed wolf hood, oversized sleeves, cuff chains, and paw slippers.
